instruction: In pylint/checkers/classes/class_checker.py, write the _AccessNodes alias in the modern form: annotate it as a TypeAlias and spell its value as nodes.Attribute | nodes.AssignAttr, in place of Union[...]. On the from typing import line, import TypeAlias in place of Union, which nothing uses afterwards. Change nothing else.

require.match: (?m)^from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, NamedTuple, TypeAlias$
